verdict.rationale: treg is an API platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows documented operations and a published OpenAPI spec, but nothing on API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Documentation and an OpenAPI file are related but different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
